entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF-881-2950.
Okay, I can definitely look into that for you. Pulling up VF-881-2950 now... I see the Velo-Pro cycling shoes. To process this correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue?
They don't fit. I've taken them on two rides, tried adjusting the cleats, but they're causing painful blisters. I just want my money back.
I understand completely. Getting blisters from new cycling shoes is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
Just tell me yes or no. Can I get a refund?

Yes, absolutely. I see here you received them 40 days ago, which is unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy for standard items. I've just initiated the return process for a full refund. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file now. Do you have the original box?
Yes. So I just print the label and send it back?
That's correct. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Okay, fine. I've got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
